verdict.rationale: Exa is a SaaS search and Websets platform that holds user data (websets, enrichments, account data), so data portability is a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the pack documents a bulk export of a user's data in open formats or an account-exit path. Structured JSON responses from search calls and webhook callbacks are per-request API features, not a user data export, so they earn no credit here.
